_about: The rulebook is the single source of truth for rules and constants. Agents and tools must read values from here and cite them. status: 'official' = taken from a government or regulator document. 'vendor-guide-verify' = from company guides, MUST be verified against the official scheme guidelines before the demo. 'team-assumption' = our own illustrative number.

subsidy_per_kw_ghs.source: MNRE / PM Surya Ghar subsidy structure sheet (CFA_structure20240307.pdf)
subsidy_per_kw_ghs.note: For common facilities of Group Housing Societies / RWAs, including EV charging.

cap_kw_per_flat.source: MNRE / PM Surya Ghar subsidy structure sheet
cap_kw_per_flat.note: A CEILING, not a target. Size to the common-meter load.

cap_total_kw_ghs.source: MNRE / PM Surya Ghar subsidy structure sheet
cap_total_kw_ghs.note: Also counts any solar already installed by individual flat owners.

grid_emission_factor.source: Central Electricity Authority, CO2 Baseline Database User Guide v21.0
grid_emission_factor.note: Check for a newer CEA version before the final submission.

yield_kwh_per_kw_year.source: Company guides quote 1,400 to 1,800. We use the low end to stay conservative.
yield_kwh_per_kw_year.note: Location dependent. Replace with a sourced city value if available.

target_share_of_load.source: Our design choice, to avoid oversizing.

cost_per_kw.source: Company guides quote roughly 45,000 to 60,000 INR per kW.

price_band_per_kw.source: Derived from the guide range, widened slightly.
price_band_per_kw.note: Outside the band is a flag, not a verdict.

default_tariff_inr_per_kwh.source: Illustrative. Real value depends on state and tariff class; read it from the bill.

advance_flag_pct.source: Our policy threshold for flagging a large advance payment.

min_service_years.source: Our threshold for flagging a short service/maintenance period.

sign_before_approval_warning.value: Signing with an installer or paying a large advance before DISCOM approval may put the subsidy at risk.
sign_before_approval_warning.source: Several company guides. Verify in the official guidelines.
sign_before_approval_warning.note: Show as a warning, never as law.

empanelled_vendor_requirement.value: Use an installer from the official empanelled/registered vendor list; a non-listed installer may void the subsidy.
empanelled_vendor_requirement.source: Company guides. Verify on the national portal.

missed_inspection_rule.value: Guides say repeated missed DISCOM inspection appointments can lead to cancellation.

stages.source: Vendor guides. Real timelines often run longer (IEEFA reported 45 to 120 days overall).
stages.note: Used for chasing logic; not an official SLA.
